description: Stabilize the power/drainage spine, ferry coast groups, and cool the inland route just in time: the generator goes on the basin platform and the pump keeps the drainage basin low, so the low causeway stays open for the high village's long walk and the ferry terminal stays powered; the orchard crosses the west flow before the lava; two skiffs ferry the waterfront to two landings; the inland crossing is cooled the moment the research group reaches its bank; the harbour mouth is cooled in the last window so the final ferry route is open at the end. Step t=10400 repeats the last cooling for the Relaxed clock.
